title: Music Photographer
description: A music photographer's portfolio built like a slide show in a dark room: full-page crossfade hero, a full-bleed one-frame-per-viewport reel, sequenced live/festival/studio collections with a lightbox, about, real online session booking — bands pick show coverage, a promo shoot, or a studio session and a time from the photographer's actual weekly calendar — a show-booking form for the dates a calendar can't hold, and a client-galleries page that walks bands and labels through private proofing (gallery link, access code, picks sent straight to the studio), with a sample room to try. A multi-page site edited in one content file, art-directed in the marquee register (stage-black, white type, film grain).

forms.$comment: Managed-form kinds, formKey -> kind (append-only vocabulary: RSVP | LEAD | MAILING_LIST | PROOFING). The /book page's show-booking form is a lead pipeline — the code-side formKey is `booking` (PhotographyMusicPage's leadFormKey). Live proofing selections POST /__proofing/select (not the forms pipeline); proofing-selection is declared PROOFING so the Inbox renders a typed proofing tab pointing at the Client galleries surface. platformServices above declares the proofing platform service (rooms + selections as platform rows behind the /__proofing doors) — compose merges it into the deploy manifest's contentDomains so the Manage rail gates the Client galleries surface.

theme.$comment: The marquee register's overlay: mode dark opens the site in its native stage-night appearance (the appearance toggle still swaps to the white tour-program variant), and the preset's white-on-black ink rides as the project brand so app-side surfaces wear the same strict monochrome register as the marketing pages instead of the kernel default blue. Brand values match the marquee preset's own light/dark accents — the marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so keeping them identical means the overlay re-brands the app without shifting the pages.

contentContract.$comment: The pack's content slots, as data (packs/README.md 'Content contract'). Declares what a composer (agent or tool) must bind for a generated variant of this pack to present as real: slot paths into the typed content module, their kinds, and minimums. Authored alongside the module and guarded by the pack's content tests — the module satisfies the contract; the contract never drifts ahead of it.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed, merged over repobot.content.json at compose (the care pack's discipline). The appointments domain mirrors content.ts codeAppointments entry for entry (the booking tests pin the twin), so the Manage session calendar opens on exactly the sessions the site already offers, and the platform projects exactly the capacity-1 slots the sandbox simulation shows on /book. The seed is booking mode 2's input: the platform generates a booking_session per provider x window x session type occurrence, capacity 1, with the provider-wide overlap lock making double-booking impossible. Session durations are minutes; windows are weekday index (0 = Sunday) x minutes since midnight.

types.name: Live show coverage
types.description: Load-in through the encore, from the wings — one night, one room, the whole set. The evening block holds soundcheck onward.

types.name: Promo shoot
types.description: Two hours on location or backstage for the press kit, the poster, and the record sleeve — available light, no seamless paper.

types.name: Studio session
types.description: Three hours in the room while you track — playback huddles, the booth, the setlist nobody can read. The frames the reissue will want.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (web/app/src/View/PhotographyMusic/PhotographyMusicPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig). pages seeds each page's layout skeleton — ids match musicLanding.ts; the platform's structural editor edits these. style must ride the overlay: the compose merge keeps the kernel document's root style otherwise, and applySitePageDocument makes the document preset outrank every page's pinned one. The preset is marquee (the stage-night register: warm near-black, tungsten playbill caps, spotlight wash, pushed grain — the photographs are the only color) — the show itself, deliberately apart from tourbook's field journal and atelier's gallery hush.
